paths.basis: Registered mask relief, distinct entry and parallel edges around return bend at right of centre switch. Strong on 8918, same two bends and straight upper run in 8917. Apparent transverse width from 8918 intensity scan; NOT etched-width metrology. Stop short of FPC foot and switch shadow; no terminal assigned.

Separately resolved masked run between perforated field and mid switch in 8918. Visible straight then diagonal before case occlusion. 8917 raised housing hides the diagonal: not a verified termination or independently observed pin pair.
The adjacent masked run with separate bend at centre switch, 8918; ends clipped at the last resolved straight below FPC toe and at package edge. Not continued into a pad.
